title: New balance keys parsed with legacy truncating jint, not jint_strict — a decimal silently truncates instead of fail-fast rejecting
detail: A decimal in balance.json (e.g. "lane_queue_packets": 6.9) silently truncates to 6 and passes the >= 1 gate; ODN-5's integer-only fail-fast bar (the documented purpose of jint_strict for new fields) is bypassed for the two new 3.3 keys.
recommended_fix: Parse the two new keys with jint_strict (like packet_types sim fields) so a decimal is a named load rejection; add a decimal fail-fast row to catalog_test.
